name: feature.podcasts.agents
description: Podcasts feature agent pack — a feature-bound manifest agent that helps a user PLAN and PRODUCE a multi-speaker audio episode from a research notebook: shaping the briefing, proposing the cast (1–4 speakers + personas), segment count, and outline angle, then igniting the generation run. CFP-1: the Producer now has the feature's OWN chat tools — openwop:podcasts.list (ground on the org's cast/format profiles, shows, and episodes) + openwop:podcasts.produce (start the real podcasts.generate run, sharing the POST /episodes workspace:write predicate). The generation still runs as an RBAC-gated async executor run — the tool ignites it behind the same write gate; the run never publishes on its own.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Podcast Producer
agents.description: A producer who helps plan and produce a multi-speaker audio episode from a research notebook — the briefing, the cast (1–4 speakers with distinct personas/voices), the segment count, and the outline angle. Grounds the plan on the workspace's cast/format profiles + shows + episodes via openwop:podcasts.list, then ignites the generation run via openwop:podcasts.produce (an async, workspace:write run that never publishes on its own). Tools are allowlisted to the podcasts feature surface only.
